content:
Implemented and committed the configurable error stack serialization changes on branch `feature/error-stack` in commit `b67c5f9`.

Verification: the TypeScript build succeeded, and the frame and cause round-trip check passed. The functional test run passed 81 tests with the performance test excluded. In two full-suite runs, that test failed its 700 ms threshold, taking about 1.9 seconds. Two later build attempts also ended in intermittent segmentation faults, although other build runs succeeded.
